name: walk-the-dog
title: Walk the dog, ship the feature
html:
Walk the dog, ship the feature

When there’s no time left to type code: family, a new dog, a phone in one hand and a leash in the other.

  • Claude Code Remote Control on the phone, a personal Max account at home.
  • Test first, every change: Gherkin, a red run, the code, a green run, a gated commit.
  • Evidence, not trust: the gates log every step, so what passed is on record when I get home.
  • The result: repeatable, reliable RISE behaviour, built a few sentences at a time.

hooks.json

Remote Control

Please give me an update

Red run logged. Writing the fix.

How’s it going?

Green. pre-commit: TDD ordering check passed.

Illustrative, not a transcript. The two questions are the real ones, every evening.
say: The honest frame. Free time collapsed: family, a new dog. Typing code stopped being possible. What remained: Claude Code's Remote Control on a phone, a personal Max account, and a test-first discipline strong enough that the code can be trusted while I'm out on a walk. The humor is real: the messages really were that short.
